import requests, sys, time, uuid

BASE = '{{TESTVDB_DB_URL}}'

# Test count_consistency on /v1/schema: insert entities then verify count
c = 'TestCountConsistency_' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]

# Delete if exists
requests.delete(f'{BASE}/v1/schema/{c}')

# Create schema with ALL required params
payload = {
    "class": c,
    "vectorizer": "none",
    "vectorIndexConfig": {
        "distance": "cosine",
        "efConstruction": 128,
        "maxConnections": 32,
        "dynamicEfMin": 10,
        "dynamicEfMax": 500,
        "dynamicEfFactor": 8
    },
    "replicationConfig": {
        "factor": 1
    },
    "multiTenancyConfig": {
        "enabled": False
    },
    "properties": [
        {
            "name": "text",
            "dataType": ["text"]
        }
    ]
}

r = requests.post(f'{BASE}/v1/schema', json=payload)
assert r.status_code == 200, f'Create schema failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}'
print(f'Schema created: {r.status_code}')
time.sleep(0.5)

# Insert 5 objects
ids = [str(uuid.uuid4()) for _ in range(5)]
for i, oid in enumerate(ids):
    r = requests.post(f'{BASE}/v1/objects', json={
        'class': c,
        'id': oid,
        'vector': [0.1*(i+1), 0.2*(i+1), 0.3*(i+1), 0.4*(i+1)],
        'properties': {'text': f'item{i}'}
    })
    assert r.status_code == 200, f'Insert failed: {r.status_code} {r.text}'
    print(f'Inserted item{i}: {r.status_code}')

time.sleep(1)

# Verify count
r2 = requests.get(f'{BASE}/v1/objects?class={c}&limit=100')
assert r2.status_code == 200, f'Query failed: {r2.status_code} {r2.text}'
data = r2.json()
count = data.get('totalResults', -1)
print(f'totalResults: {count}')

if count != 5:
    print(f'[DEFECT: STATE_LOGIC_VIOLATION] insert 5 objects but totalResults={count}')
    sys.exit(1)
else:
    print(f'totalResults consistent: {count} == 5')
    sys.exit(0)
